## Limit Theorems

### Limits Respect Order

::: {#prp-limit-nonneg}
If $a_n \to L$ and $a_n \geq 0$ for all $n$, then $L \geq 0$.
:::

::: {#cor-limit-preserves-order}
If $a_n \to L$, $b_n \to M$, and $a_n \leq b_n$ for all $n$, then $L \leq M$.
:::

::: {#thm-squeeze}
## Squeeze Theorem
If $a_n \leq b_n \leq c_n$ and $a_n \to L$ and $c_n \to L$, then $b_n \to L$.
:::

### Limits Respect Algebra

::: {#thm-limit-sum}
## Limits of Sums
If $a_n \to L$ and $b_n \to M$, then $a_n + b_n \to L + M$.
:::

::: {#thm-limit-product}
## Limits of Products
If $a_n \to L$ and $b_n \to M$, then $a_n b_n \to LM$.
:::

::: {#thm-limit-quotient}
## Limits of Quotients (Exercise)
If $a_n \to L$ and $b_n \to M$ with $M \neq 0$ and $b_n \neq 0$, then $a_n/b_n \to L/M$.
:::

::: {#thm-limit-sqrt}
## Limits of Square Roots
If $a_n \to L$ with $a_n \geq 0$ and $L \geq 0$, then $\sqrt{a_n} \to \sqrt{L}$.
:::

### Applications: Finishing What We Started

::: {#thm-geometric-series}
## Geometric Series
For $|r| < 1$: $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} r^n = \frac{1}{1-r}$.
:::

::: {#prp-nth-root-n}
$n^{1/n} \to 1$.
:::

::: {#thm-babylonian-sqrt2}
## Babylonian Convergence II
The sequence $x_1 = 2$, $x_{n+1} = (x_n + 2/x_n)/2$ converges to $\sqrt{2}$.
:::

### Density and Approximation

::: {#prp-rationals-approximate}
Every real number is the limit of a sequence of rationals.
:::
